scopes.read: Read app status, recent captures, library items, and settings.
scopes.capture: Take screenshots, OCR captures, and scrolling captures.
scopes.record: Start, pause, resume, restart, and stop targeted video or GIF recordings.
scopes.edit: Open captures in the screenshot editor, trimmers, or Studio; make structured Studio project edits.
scopes.export: Export or copy captures and Studio projects.
scopes.delete: Delete captures or projects. Always needs in-app approval.
scopes.upload: Upload or share captures to a remote service. Always needs in-app approval.
scopes.discard: Discard recordings or unsaved work. Always needs in-app approval.

commands.name: app.status
commands.description: App name, version, platform, recording state, and automation state.

commands.name: app.open
commands.description: Open an app window.

commands.name: recording.status
commands.description: Current recording state: idle, countdown, recording, paused, or processing.

commands.name: library.list
commands.description: List recent captures, newest first.

commands.name: settings.get
commands.description: Read automation-visible settings.

commands.name: capture.targets
commands.description: List available displays and visible windows for unattended capture. IDs are ephemeral and valid for this app session.

commands.name: capture.screenshot
commands.description: Take a screenshot without showing a picker. For region use displayId and a display-local physical-pixel rectangle; for window use a windowId from capture.targets.

region.description: Display-local rectangle in physical pixels, with a top-left origin.

commands.name: capture.ocr
commands.description: Recognize text in a screen, display region, or window without showing a picker or changing the clipboard.

region.description: Display-local rectangle in physical pixels, with a top-left origin.

commands.name: recording.startVideo
commands.description: Start a video recording without a picker or setup window, using the supplied target and saved recording settings. studio=true records a Studio project.

region.description: Display-local rectangle in physical pixels, with a top-left origin.

commands.name: recording.startGif
commands.description: Start a GIF recording without a picker, using the supplied target and saved recording settings.

region.description: Display-local rectangle in physical pixels, with a top-left origin.

commands.name: capture.scrolling.start
commands.description: Start stitching a screen, display region, or window into a scrolling screenshot without a target picker. Scroll the content in the target application, then call capture.scrolling.stop.

region.description: Display-local rectangle in physical pixels, with a top-left origin.

commands.name: capture.scrolling.stop
commands.description: Stop the active scrolling screenshot, stitch the captured frames, and save a new library item without opening the editor.

commands.name: capture.scrolling.status
commands.description: Get the active scrolling capture state and accepted frame count.

commands.name: capture.scrolling.cancel
commands.description: Cancel and discard the active scrolling screenshot. Requires in-app approval.

commands.name: recording.stop
commands.description: Stop the active recording and save it.

commands.name: recording.togglePause
commands.description: Pause or resume the active recording.

commands.name: recording.restart
commands.description: Discard the current take and restart recording.

commands.name: recording.discard
commands.description: Stop and discard the active recording.

commands.name: editor.open
commands.description: Open a capture file in the matching editor (screenshot editor, video/GIF trimmer, or Studio).

commands.name: studio.projects.list
commands.description: List Studio projects stored by Tiny Clips, newest activity first.

commands.name: studio.project.get
commands.description: Read a Studio project and its editable timeline, look, and audio settings by project ID; returns a revision token for safe edits.

commands.name: studio.project.edit
commands.description: Apply an atomic partial update to editable Studio project properties. Supply expectedModifiedAt and expectedRevision from studio.project.get; arrays replace their whole field. Identity, name, sources, keepSources, and exports cannot be changed.

commands.name: studio.zoom.suggest
commands.description: Return suggested zooms from a Studio project's click events without changing the project.

commands.name: studio.export
commands.description: Render a Studio project to a new MP4 at outputPath. Existing files are never overwritten; output must be outside the project and source folders.

commands.name: editor.annotate
commands.description: Apply structured annotations to a screenshot and save a new library copy without opening the editor. Coordinates and points are image pixels from the top left. The source is never overwritten.

commands.name: library.reveal
commands.description: Reveal a capture in Finder or File Explorer.

commands.name: library.copy
commands.description: Copy a capture file to the clipboard.

commands.name: settings.set
commands.description: Change an automation-visible setting.

commands.name: library.delete
commands.description: Move a capture to the Trash or Recycle Bin.

commands.name: library.upload
commands.description: Upload a capture with the configured upload service and return its URL.

errors.automation_disabled: Agent control is turned off in Settings.
errors.unauthorized: Missing, unknown, or revoked client token.
errors.missing_scope: The client was not granted the scope this command needs.
errors.approval_denied: The user declined or did not answer the in-app approval.
errors.unknown_command: The command name is not in the contract.
errors.not_supported: The command is in the contract but not available on this platform or build.
errors.busy: The app cannot run the command in its current state.
errors.permission_required: An OS permission (Screen Recording, Microphone, Camera) is missing.
errors.not_found: The file or item does not exist.
